limitations: Finite real signals and row-stochastic matrices; no assertion of optimal constants restricted to symmetric stochastic matrices. First public date is that of the 2013 lead preprint, not the 1993 background journal publication.
scientific_integrity: A complete all-size proof and explicit sharp examples are supplied; finite exact-rational checks corroborate but do not establish the general result. Novelty is provisional against unindexed older literature; no external independent audit has occurred.
title: A sharp two-sided Gini–Dobrushin comparison for finite Markov operators
